name: git-breakout-lxz-401
description: Terminal-styled GitHub contribution Breakout game for lxz-401

scripts.web: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'), {exec}=require('child_process'); const port=3000; http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let fp = path.join(__dirname, req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url); fs.readFile(fp, (err,data)=>{ if(err){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found');}else{ const ext=path.extname(fp); const mime = ext==='.css'?'text/css':ext==='.js'?'text/javascript':'text/html'; res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime}); res.end(data); } }); }).listen(port, ()=>{ console.log('Serving on http://localhost:'+port); exec('start http://localhost:'+port); });"
